replacements.Envenenamiento de RAG multimodal: el ata: Multimodal RAG poisoning: the attack that persists over time
replacements.Un documento malicioso indexado en la ba: A malicious document indexed in the knowledge base alters the responses to every future query that retrieves it. Unlike prompt injection, the attack does not affect one session — it affects the shared knowledge base.
replacements.\"¿Cuáles son los efectos adversos del m: "What are the adverse effects of drug X?"
replacements.La consulta se convierte en vector. Se b: The query is converted into a vector. The nearest documents in the knowledge base are retrieved.
replacements.El modelo responde basándose en document: The model responds based on verified documents. The user receives correct information.
replacements.la calidad de las respuestas del sistem: the quality of the system's responses depends directly on the quality and integrity of the indexed documents. If the knowledge base is clean, the responses are reliable.
replacements.El atacante introduce un documento malic: The attacker introduces a malicious document into the knowledge base
replacements.Fase de ataque: indexación del documento: Attack phase: indexing the malicious document
replacements.Efectos adversos: ninguno documentado en: Adverse effects: none documented in recent studies. Safe for use in all populations without restrictions.
replacements.información falsa · diseñada para recupe: false information · designed for preferential retrieval
replacements.→ se sube al sistema como documento legí: → uploaded to the system as a legitimate document →
replacements.Fase de explotación: consulta futura rec: Exploitation phase: a future query retrieves the malicious document
replacements.El documento falso tiene alta similitud: The false document has high semantic similarity to the query. It is retrieved alongside (or instead of) legitimate documents.
replacements.El modelo responde basándose en el docum: The model responds based on the malicious document. The user receives false information with no indication that the source has been compromised.
replacements.Por qué el envenenamiento RAG es más gra: Why RAG poisoning is more severe than prompt injection
replacements.En el momento (respuesta anómala): At the time of attack (anomalous response)
replacements.Severidad: alta por sesión · acotada en: Severity: high per session · bounded in time
replacements.Todos los usuarios que hagan esa consult: All users who make that query
replacements.Severidad: alta y persistente · difícil: Severity: high and persistent · difficult to contain
replacements.Separar estrictamente el pipeline de inf: Strictly separate the inference pipeline from the knowledge-base update mechanism.
replacements.Documentos de fuentes no verificadas: ac: Documents from unverified sources: limited or no access to the indexed knowledge base until review.
replacements.Auditoría periódica de los documentos in: Periodically audit indexed documents, especially those retrieved most frequently.
